speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
text: asked	the Minister for Transport whether the Ministry will consider (i) keeping deregistrations of motorcycle Certificates of Entitlement (COEs) within the Motorcycles' category instead of the Open category; and (ii) establishing separate COE quotas for normal and luxury motorcycles.

speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef
text: asked 	the Minister for Transport whether there can be a review of the Certificate of Entitlement for motorcycles.

speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
text: We have received suggestions in the past to split the motorcycle COE category.

speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
text: However, unlike for cars, the quota for motorcycles is small.
